edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier enforces that _owner equals _msgSender before withdraw executes
withdraw performs an external value transfer to the caller
withdraw reads address(this).balance into the balance local variable
balance value flows into the transfer amount
transferred Ether is sent to msg.sender, an external untrusted account
reserveDogs is guarded by onlyOwner checking _owner
_count parameter drives the reserve loop bound
totalSupply is stored in supply and used to compute mint ids
reserveDogs calls _safeMint which triggers the receiver callback
reserved tokens are minted to msg.sender
setRevealTimestamp is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
revealTimeStamp parameter is consumed by the setter
revealTimeStamp is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP
setProvenanceHash is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
provenanceHash parameter is consumed by the setter
provenanceHash is written into DD_PROVENANCE
setBaseURI is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
baseURI parameter is passed to _setBaseURI
flipSaleState is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive flag
numberOfTokens parameter drives loop and validation logic
mintDog requires saleIsActive to be true
numberOfTokens is compared against maxDogPurchase
total supply plus requested count is bounded by MAX_DOGS
dogPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) is an arithmetic cost computation
mintDog branches on block.timestamp compared to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP participates in the reveal condition based on block.timestamp
mintIndex is computed from totalSupply each loop iteration
computed mintIndex is passed into _safeMint which invokes the receiver callback
mintDog calls _safeMint triggering an external ERC721 receiver callback
minted tokens are sent to msg.sender and msg.value is trusted from the caller
startingIndexBlock is set from block.number inside mintDog
setStartingIndex computes a modulo of blockhash, the pseudo-random source
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock for the blockhash lookup
blockhash result is reduced modulo MAX_DOGS
computed value is written to startingIndex
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock
transferOwnership is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable
renounceOwnership is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner
renounceOwnership zeros out the _owner state variable
constructor initializes MAX_DOGS from maxNftSupply
constructor initializes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from saleStart

normalization_plan.reason: _count is only used inside reserveDogs to bound the mint loop
numberOfTokens is only used inside mintDog for validation and looping
revealTimeStamp is only used inside setRevealTimestamp
provenanceHash is only used inside setProvenanceHash
baseURI is only used inside setBaseURI
balance local directly feeds the unsafe Ether transfer operation
supply local is only used inside reserveDogs to compute mint ids
mintIndex local is only used inside mintDog to index _safeMint
